description: Registration helpers for the wireframe MCP tools.

members.name: AddTempoWireframeMcpTools
members.description: Registers the dependencies the wireframe MCP tools resolve from DI (the component schema registry). The host must additionally supply an ITempoDocumentLibraryProvider and an IWireframeDocumentProvider, and register the tools with its MCP server via ToolTypes.

members.name: ToolTypes
members.description: The wireframe tool types, exposed for hosts that register tools by type. Prefer WithToolsFromAssembly(typeof(TempoWireframeMcp).Assembly), which also advertises the tools capability in the handshake.
